English: This study examined the impact of insecurity on the entrepreneurial activities of women in Shiroro Local Government Area of Niger State, focusing specifically on issues about women’s financial dependence, the kind of entrepreneurial activities common among them and the dimension of the impact of insecurity on their entrepreneurial endeavours.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwekaliriza obutali butebenkenvu n’engeri gye kukosaamu abakyala bye bakola mu kukola bizinensi mu Kitundu kya Gavumenti y’Ekitundu mu SHIRORO, Niger State, nga kutunuulira ensonga ezo zokka ezikwata ku kwetengerera kw’abakyala mu byenfuna, ebintu bye batera okukola okutondawo bizinensi wamu n’obutalibutebenkevu mu bye bayiiya okutondawo bizinensi.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí ṣàgbéyẹ̀wò ipa tí àìsáàbò lórí àwọn iṣẹ́ ìsòwò àwọn obìnrin ní Agbègbè Ìjọba Ìbílẹ̀ Shiroro tó wà ní Ìpílẹ̀ Niger, pàápàá jùlọ àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ lórí àríyànjiyàn àwọn obìnrin lórí ìdádúró nípa ìnáwó, irúfẹ́ òwò tó wọ́pọ̀ láàárín wọn àti abala ipa tí àìsáàbò ń kó lórí akitiyan ìsòwò wọn.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo luhlole umthelela wokungavikeleki emisebenzini yezamabhizinisi yabesifazane e-Shiroro Local Government Area of ​​Niger State, igxile kakhulu ezindabeni ezimayelana nokuncika kwabesifazane ngokwezimali, uhlobo lwemisebenzi yezamabhizinisi evamile phakathi kwabo kanye nobukhulu bomthelela wokungavikeleki emabhizinisini abo.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya yi nazari ne a kan illar rashin tsaro ga harkokin kasuwanci da mata suke yi a Ƙaramar Hukumar Shiroro ta Jihar Neja, inda ya mayar da hankali, musamman a kan batutuwan da suka shafi dogaro da kuɗaɗen mata, da irin harkokin kasuwanci da ya zama ruwan dare a tsakaninsu da kuma girman tasirin rashin tsaro a kan harkokin kasuwancinsu.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di lekotše seabe sa tlhokegho ya tšhireletšego go mediro ya bohlomikgwebo ka basadi ka Lefelong la Mmušo wa Selegae wa Shiroro la Mmušo wa Niger, di lebeletše kudu ka ga merero ya go se ikeme ditšheleteng ga basadi, mehuta ya mediro ye itšego ya bohlomikgwebo yeo e tlwaelegilego gareng ga bona le lehlakore la seabe sa tlhokego ya tšhireletšego go maitekelo a bona a bohlomikgwebo.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት በኒጄር ግዛት በሺሮሮ የአካባቢ አስተዳደር የደህንነት እጦት የሴቶች የስራ ፈጠራ እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ያለውን ተፅእኖ በተለይም የሴቶችን የፋይናንስ ጥገኝነት፣ በመካከላቸው ያለውን የጋራ የስራ ፈጠራ እንቅስቃሴ ዓይነት እና የየደህንነት እጦት በስራ ፈጠራ ጥረቶች ላይ የሚኖረውን ተፅእኖ በተመለከተ ትኩረት በመስጠት ይመረምራል።

English: A sample of 377 women was surveyed, leading to the findings that women in Shiroro are highly entrepreneurial with high level of financial independence, engaging mostly in SMEs.
Luganda: Sampolo y’abakyala 377 be baatunuulira era ebyavaamu ne biraga nti abakyala b’omu Shiroro ba batandisi ba bizinensi era nga beetengerera ddala mu byenfuna, era nga basinga kwenyigira mu bizinensi entonotono eziyitibwa SME.
Yoruba: Àpẹẹrẹ àwọn obìnrin 377 ní wọ́n tọpinpin, èyí tó já sí àwọn àwárí pé àwọn obìnrin ní Shiroro jẹ́ oníṣòwò gidi, wọ́n sì ní òmìnira ìnáwó tó dáńgájíá, àwọn SME sì ni wọ́n ma ń lọ́wọ́ sí jù.
Zulu: Kwahlolwa isampula yabesifazane abangama-377, okuholele ekutholakaleni kokuthi abesifazane baseShiroro bangosomabhizinisi abanezinga eliphezulu lokuzimela ngokwezimali, bazibandakanya kakhulu nama-SME.
Hausa: An yi nazarin samfurin mata guda 377, wanda ya kai ga gano cewa mata a Shiroro sun kasance masu sana'o’i ne sosai tare da samun ‘yancin kai na kuɗi, galibi suna shiga SMEs.
Northern Sotho: Sampole ya basadi ba 377 e ile ya lekolwa, gomme yona e ile ya feletša ka dikutollo tša gore basadi ba ka Shiroro ba na le bohlomikgwebno kudu fao go nago le maemo a godimo ga go se ikeme ditšheleteng, fao ba hlomilego kudu dikgwebopotlana le dikgwebo tša magareng (di-SME).
Amharic: 377 ናሙና ሴቶች ላይ የዳሰሳ ጥናት ተካሂዶ ነበር፣ ይህም በሽሮሮ ውስጥ ያሉ ሴቶች ከፍተኛ የፋይናንስ ነጻነት ያላቸው፣ በአብዛኛው በአነስተኛ እና ጥቃቅን ተቋማት ውስጥ የተሰማሩ ከፍተኛ የስራ ፈጣሪዎች ናቸው።

English: The study also found that while insecurity has an adverse effect on women’s entrepreneurial activities in the form of loss of or decline of capital among other things, the number of women entrepreneurs has not experienced a significant decline.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza era kwazuula nti wadde ng’obutalibutebenkevu bukosa abakyala bye bakola mu kutandikawo bizinensi mu ngeri y’okufiirwa oba okukendeera mu ssente z’entandikwa n’ebiringa ebyo, omuwendo gw’abakyala batandikawo bizinensi tegukendedde nnyo.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí náà tún ṣàwárí pé pẹ̀lú bí àìsáàbò ṣe nípá burúkú tó ń kó lórí iṣẹ́ ìṣòwò tó je mọ́ àwọn obìnrin bíi pípàdánù tàbí ìdínkù owó ìdókoòwò láàárín ohun púpọ̀, iye àwọn obìnrin oníṣòwò ò tíì fi bẹ́ẹ̀ rí ìdínkù púpọ̀.
Zulu: Ucwaningo luphinde lwathola ukuthi nakuba ukungavikeleki kunomphumela omubi emisebenzini yabesifazane yamabhizinisi ngendlela yokulahlekelwa noma ukwehla kwezimali phakathi kwezinye izinto, isibalo sabesifazane abangosomabhizinisi asizange sibe nokwehla okukhulu.
Hausa: Har ila yau binciken ya gano cewa, a yayin da rashin tsaro yake da illa ga harkokin kasuwanci na mata ta hanyar asara ko raguwar jari a tsakanin sauran abubuwa, adadin mata masu sana’ar kasuwanci bai samu wani gagarumin koma baya ba.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di hweditše gape gore le ge e le gore tlhokego ya tšhireletšego e na le seabe sa go se kgahliše kudu go mediro ya bohlomikgwebo ya basadi ka tsela ya tahlegelo goba ya go phuhlama ga letlotlo gareng ga tše dingwe, palo ya basadi bao ba hlomago dikgwebo ga se ya itemogela go fokotšega kudu.
Amharic: ጥናቱ በተጨማሪም የደህንነት እጦት በሴቶች የስራ ፈጠራ እንቅስቃሴ ላይ በካፒታል መጥፋት ወይም ማሽቆልቆል መልኩ አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ ቢኖረውም፣ የሴቶች ስራ ፈጣሪዎች ቁጥር ከፍተኛ የሆነ ማሽቆልቆል አልገጠመውም።

English: The study recommended that sustainable programmes to improve women’s access to and use of financial services should be created and community policing organisations should also be created and strengthened to combat insecurity in the study area.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwasemba nti enteekateeka ezibeerera ezongera omutindo ku bakyala ku kukozesa n’okufuna obuweereza bw’ebyensimbi birina okuteekebwawo era n’ebitongole by’omu kitundu ebirondoozi birina okuteekebwawo era n’okwongerwamu amaanyi okuziyiza obutalibutebenkevu mu kitundu.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí dábàá pé ó yẹ kí wọ́n ṣẹ̀dá àwọn ètò tó ṣeé gbéró láti rí ìlọsíwájú àrọ́wọ́tó àwọn obìnrin sí àwọn ètò ajẹmówó àti ìlò wọn, àti pé ó yẹ kí wọ́n ṣẹ̀dá, kí wọ́n sì kín àwọn ẹ̀gbẹ́ ọdẹ àdúgbò lẹ́yìn láti gbógun tí àìsáàbò ní agbègbè àfojúsùn náà.
Zulu: Ucwaningo luncome ukuthi izinhlelo ezisimeme zokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwabesifazane kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo zezezimali kufanele zidalwe futhi izinhlangano zamaphoyisa zomphakathi nazo kufanele zidalwe futhi ziqiniswe ukuze kuliwe nokungavikeleki endaweni yocwaningo.
Hausa: Binciken ya bayar da shawarar cewa ya kamata a samar da tsare-tsare masu ɗorewa domin inganta hanyoyin samun damar mata da kuma amfani da ayyukan kuɗi da kuma samar da ƙungiyoyin ‘yan sandan al’umma da kuma ƙarfafa su domin yaƙi da rashin tsaro a yankin binciken.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di šišintšer gore mananeo a go ya go ile a go kaionafatša phihlelelo ya basadi go ditirelo tša ditšhelete le go šomiša e swanetše go hlongwa gomme mekgatlo ya go hlapetša ditšhaba le yona e swanetše go hlongwa le go maatlafatšwa go lwantšha tlhokego ya tšhireletšego ka lekaleng la dinyakišišo.
Amharic: ጥናቱ ሴቶች ለፋይናንስ አገልግሎት ያላቸውን ተደራሽነት እና ተጠቃሚነት ለማሻሻል ዘላቂነት ያላቸው ፕሮግራሞች እንዲፈጠሩ እና በጥናት አካባቢ ያለውን የደህንነት እጦት ለመቋቋም የማህበረሰብ አቀፍ ፖሊስ ድርጅቶችን መፍጠር እና ማጠናከር እንደሚገባ ምክረ ሃሳብ ሰጥቷል።

English: Researchers found that businesswomen in Niger are highly entrepreneurial and financially independent, but safety from criminals is an issue.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakizuula nti abakyala bannabizinensi mu Niger bayiiya nnyo era beetengeredde mu byenfuna, naye ebyokerinda eri abamenyi b’amateeka nsonga yamaanyi.

Zulu: Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi osomabhizinisi besifazane eNiger bangosomabhizinisi futhi bazimele ngokwezimali, kodwa ukuphepha ezigebengwini kuyinkinga.

English: Researchers wanted to know how safe and secure women who run businesses in the Shiroro Local Government Area of Niger State are, and how this may impact their businesses and financial independence.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baayagala okumanya obutebenkevu abakyala abaddukanya bizinensi mu Kitundu kya Gavumenti y’ekitundu mu Shiroro, Niger State bwe bakoleramu, n’engeri obutebenkevu obwo gye bukosa bizinensi zaabwe n’obwetengereze mu byenfuna.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ mọ bí àwọn obìnrin ní Agbègbè Ìjọba Ìbílẹ̀ SHIRORO ti Ìpílẹ̀ Niger ṣe wà ní ààbò àti àìléwu sí, àti bí èyí ṣe lè nípá lórí òmìnira ìṣòwò àti ìnáwó wọn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bebefuna ukwazi ukuthi baphephe futhi bavikelekile kangakanani abesifazane abaqhuba amabhizinisi endaweni yaseShiroro Local Government Area of ​​Niger State, nokuthi lokhu kungase kube nomthelela onjani emabhizinisini abo kanye nokuzimela kwezezimali.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun so sanin yadda matan da suke gudanar da sana’o’i a Ƙaramar Hukumar Shiroro a Jihar Neja suke cikin aminci da tsaro, da kuma yadda hakan zai iya shafar kasuwancinsu da ‘yancin cin gashin kansu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go tseba gore basadi bao ba sepetšago dikgwebo ka Lefelong la Mmušo wa Selegae la Shiroro ba bolokegile le go šireletšega bjang, le gore se se ka ama dikgwebo tša bona bjang le boikemo bja ditšhelete.

English: They interviewed 377 women in this area about the challenges they face in terms of their entrepreneurial activities, financial dependencies and insecurities.
Luganda: Baabuuza abakyala 377 mu kitundu ekyo ku kusoomooza kwe basanga mu mirimu byabwe egy’okutandikawo biziensi, obwetengereze mu byenfuna n’obutalibutebenkevu.
Yoruba: Wọn ṣe ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò fún àwọn obìnrin 377 ní agbègbè yí nípa àwọn ohun tí wọ́n ń dojúkọ nípa ìṣe ìṣòwò wọn, àwọn ìgbẹ́kẹ̀lé wọn lórí ìnáwó àti àìsáàbò.
Zulu: Baxoxisane nabesifazane abangu-377 bakule ndawo mayelana nezinselelo ababhekene nazo mayelana nebhizinisi labo, ukuncika kwezezimali kanye nokungavikeleki.
Hausa: Sun tattauna da mata guda 377 a wannan fanni game da ƙalubalolin da suke fuskanta ta fuskar harkokin kasuwanci da dogaro da kuɗi da kuma rashin tsaro.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba botšiša basadi ba 377 dipotšišo ka mo lefelong le ka ga ditlhohlo tše ba lebanego le tšona mabaapi le mediro ya bona ya bohlomikgwebo, go se ikeme ditšheleteng le tlhokego ya tšhireletšego.
Amharic: በዚህ አካባቢ የሚገኙ 377 ሴቶችን በስራ ፈጠራ ተግባራቸው፣ በገንዘብ ጥገኝነት እና በደህንነታቸው ዙሪያ ስላጋጠሟቸው ተግዳሮቶች ቃለ መጠይቅ አድርገዋል።

English: They reported that 43% of the women said they did not depend on men for money, and 32% said they had other people depending on them for money.
Luganda: Baategeeza nti abakyala ebitundu 43% baagamba nti baali tebeesigamye ku basajja kubawa ssente, ate ebitundu 32% baagamba nti baalina abantu abalala abaali babeesigamyeko ku byessente.
Yoruba: Wọ́n jábọ̀ pé 43% àwọn obìnrin náà sọ pé àwọn ò gbẹ́kẹ̀lé ọkùnrn fówó, 32% wọn sì ní àwọn ní àwọn ẹlòmíràn tó ń gbẹ́kẹ̀lé àwọn fówó.
Zulu: Babike ukuthi u-43% wabesifazane uthe awuncikile kwabesilisa ukuze bathole imali, u-32% uthi unabanye abantu abathembele kubona ngemali.
Hausa: Sun bayyana cewa kashi 43% na matan sun ce ba sa dogara ga maza don neman kuɗi, kuma kashi 32% sun ce suna da wasu mutane da suke dogara da su domin neman kuɗi.
Northern Sotho: Ba begile gore 43% ya basadi ba boletše gore ga se ba tshepha banna gore ba ba fe tšhelete, gomme 32% yona e boletše gore ba na le batho ba bangwe bao ba tshephilego bona go tšhelete.
Amharic: ከሴቶቹ መካከል 43% የሚሆኑት በወንዶች ላይ ጥገኛ እንዳልሆኑ ሲገልጹ፣ 32% ደግሞ በገንዘብ ዝሪያ ሌሎች በእነሱ ላይ ጥገኛ እንደሆኑ ሪፖርት አድርጋዋል።

English: The researchers also found out that 85% of the women were making money from different businesses, and only a few said they depended on salaries.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baakizuula nti abakyala ebitundu 85% baali bakola ssente okuva mu bizinensi ez’enjawulo, ate abalala batono ddala baagamba nti baali beesigamye ku musaala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí tún ṣàwárí pé 85% àwọn obìnin náà ń pawó láti òwò oríṣiríṣi, díẹ̀ nínú wọn ni wọ́n sọ pé àwọn gbẹ́kẹ̀lé owó oṣu.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathole nokuthi u-85% wabesifazane wenza imali ngamabhizinisi ahlukene, bambalwa abathi bathembele emaholweni.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa kashi 85% na matan suna samun kuɗi ne daga sana’o’i daban-daban, kuma kaɗan ne suka ce sun dogara da albashi.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše gape gore 85% ya basadi ba be ba dira tšhelete go dikgwebo tše di fapafapanego, gomme ke fela ba mmalwa fela bao ba boletšego gore ba tshephile meputso.
Amharic: እንዲህም ተመራማሪዎቹ 85% ያህሉ ሴቶች ከተለያዩ የንግድ ስራዎች ገቢ እንደሚያገኙ ደርሰውበታል፣ ጥቂቶቹ ብቻ በደመወዝ ላይ ጥገኛ እንደሆኑ ተናግረዋል።

English: About 56% made money through farming, and 79% through trading.
Luganda: Ebitundu nga 56% baakola ssente okuva mu bulimi, ate abalala 79% nga baziggya mu bulimi.
Yoruba: Bíi 56% ló pawó látàrí iṣẹ́ àgbẹ̀, àwọn 79% látàrí ìṣòwò.
Zulu: Cishe u-56% wenze imali ngokulima, futhi u-79% wenze imali ngokuhwebelana.
Hausa: Kusan kashi 56% sun sami kuɗi ta hanyar noma, kuma 79% ta hanyar kasuwanci.
Northern Sotho: Tekano ye e ka bago 56% e dirile tšhelete ka bolemi, mola 79% ka go rekiša.
Amharic: 56% ያህሉ በእርሻ፣ እና 79% በንግድ ስራ ገቢ ያገኛሉ።

English: About 1 in 5 women earned money through plaiting hair, sewing, knitting or doing some laundry.
Luganda: Abakyala nga 1 ku 5 baali bafuna ssente okuva mu kusiba enviiri, okutunga ebyalaani, okutungisa engalo oba okwoza engoye.
Yoruba: Bíi 1 nínú 5 àwọn obìnrin ló ń pawó látàrí irun dídì, aṣọ rírán, aṣọ íhun tàbí aṣo fífọ̀.
Zulu: Cishe owesifazane oyi-1 kwabawu-5 wayethola imali ngokuluka izinwele, ukuthunga, ukunitha noma ukuwasha.
Hausa: Kusan 1 cikin mata 5 suna samun kuɗi ne ta hanyar kitso da ɗinki da saƙa ko kuma yin wanki.
Northern Sotho: Mosadi yo a ka bago yo 1 go basadi ba 5 o be a hwetša tšhelete ka go loga meriri, go roka, go loga goba go hlatswa diaparo.
Amharic: ከ 5 ሴቶች መካከል 1 ያህሉ ፀጉርን ሹሩባ በመስራት፣ በመስፋት፣ በፈትል ወይም በልብስ ማጠብ ገንዘብ ያገኛሉ።

English: Most of the women (91%) told the researchers that their businesses were affected by their fear of being attacked by thieves and criminals.
Luganda: Abakyala abasinga obungi (91%) baagamba abanoonyereza nti bizinensi zaabwe zaakosebwa olw’okutya okulumbibwa ababbi n’abamenyi b’amateeka.
Yoruba: Púpọ̀ nínú àwọn obìnrin náà (91%) sọ fún àwọn aṣèwádìí náà pé ìbẹ̀rù ìkọlu lọ́wọ́ àwọn olè àti ọ̀daràn ń kóbá ìsòwò wọn.
Zulu: Iningi labesifazane (91%) litshele abacwaningi ukuthi amabhizinisi abo athinteka ngenxa yokwesaba ukuhlaselwa amasela nezigebengu.
Hausa: Yawancin matan (91%) sun gaya wa masu binciken cewa tsoron kada ɓarayi da masu aikata laifuka su kai musu hari ya shafi kasuwancinsu.
Northern Sotho: Bontši bja basadi (91%) ba boditše banyakišiši gore dikgwebo tša bona di be di angwa ke letšhogo la bona la go hlasela ke mahodu le basenyi.
Amharic: አብዛኛዎቹ ሴቶች (91%) ለተመራማሪዎቹ እንደተናገሩት ንግዶቻቸው በሌቦች እና ወንጀለኞች ጥቃት እንዳይደርስባቸው በመፍራታቸው ተጽዕኖ ደርሶባቸዋል።

English: They lose money and even their husbands to these attacks, sometimes forcing them to provide for their children alone.
Luganda: Bafiirwa ssente wamu n’abaami baabwe mu kulumbibwa okwo, era olumu nga kibawaliriza okulabirira abaana baabwe nga tewali abakwasizaako.
Yoruba: Wọ́n pàdánù owó àti pàápàá àwọn ọkọ wọn nínú àwọn ìkọlù yí, èyí tó ń kàn wọ́n nípa láti máa dá àwọn ọmọ wọn tọ́jú.
Zulu: Balahlekelwa yimali ngisho nabayeni babo ngenxa yalokhu kuhlaselwa, ngezinye izikhathi okubaphoqa ukuba bondle izingane zabo bodwa.
Hausa: Sukan yi asarar kuɗi har ma da mazajensu sakamakon waɗannan hare-hare, wani lokaci ma sukan tilasta musu biyan buƙatun ‘ya’yansu su kaɗai.
Northern Sotho: Ba lahlegetšwe ke tšhelete le banna ba bona ka lebaka la ditlhaselo tše, ka dinako tše dingwe se sa ba gapeletša gosfepa bana ba bona ba nnoši.
Amharic: በእነዚህ ጥቃቶች ምክንያት ገንዘብን አልፎ ተርፎም ባሎቻቸውን ያጣሉ፣ አንዳንድ ጊዜ ልጆቻቸውን ብቻቸውን እንዲያሳድጉ ያስገድዳቸዋል።

English: The women also said they did not have enough skills and money to expand their businesses.
Luganda: Abakyala abo era baagamba nti tebaalina bukodyo bumala na ssente kugaziya bizinensi zaabwe.
Yoruba: Àwọn obìnrin náà tún ní àwọn ò ní ìmọ̀ṣe àti owó tó tó láti jẹ́ kí ọjà wọn gbòòrò si.
Zulu: Laba besifazane baphinde bathi abanawo amakhono nemali eyanele yokukhulisa amabhizinisi abo.
Hausa: Matan sun kuma ce ba su da isassun ƙwarewa da kuɗin da za su iya faɗaɗa sana’o’insu.
Northern Sotho: Basadi ba baboletše gape gore ga ba na bokgoni bjo bo lekanego le tšhelete go oketša dikgwebo tša bona.
Amharic: ሴቶቹ እንዲሁም ንግዳቸውን ለማስፋት በቂ ክህሎት እና ገንዘብ እንደሌላቸውም ተናግረዋል።

English: The researchers reported that despite those challenges, Niger women continued to do very well in their businesses.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baategeeza nti wadde nga balina okusoomooza okwo, abakyala b’omu Niger beeyongera okukola obulungi mu bizinensi zaabwe.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà jábọ̀ pé pẹ̀lú gbogbo ìdojúkọ wọ̀nyẹn, àwọn obìnrin Niger túnbọ̀ sí ní ṣe dáada nínú ìṣòwò wọn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babike ukuthi naphezu kwalezo zinselelo, abesifazane baseNiger baqhubekile nokwenza kahle kakhulu emabhizinisini abo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayyana cewa, duk da waɗannan ƙalubalolin, matan Neja sun ci gaba da samun ci gaba sosai a harkokin kasuwancinsu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba begile gore ka ntle le ditlhohlo tšeo, basadi ba Niger ba tšwetše pele go šoma gabotse kudu ka dikgwebong tša bona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እነዚህ ተግዳሮቶች ቢኖሩም እንኳን የኒጀር ሴቶች በንግድ ስራቸው ጥሩ መሥራታቸውን እንደቀጠሉ ሪፖርት አድርገዋል።

English: They said Shiroro had people of different tribes and religions, and this was also good for business.
Luganda: Baagamba nti ekitundu ky’e Shiroro kyalimu abantu ab’amawanga ag’enjawulo n’enzikiriza ez’enjawulo, nti era ne kino kyali kirungi mu bizinensi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní Shiroro ní àwọn èèyàn ẹlẹ́yàmẹyà àti àwon ẹlẹ́sin oríṣiríṣi, èyí sì dà fún ọrọ̀-ajẹ́.
Zulu: Bathe iShiroro inabantu bezizwe nezinkolo ezahlukene, kanti lokhu kuyasiza nasemabhizinisini.
Hausa: Sun ce Shiroro tana da mutane masu ƙabilu da addinai daban-daban, kuma wannan ma yana da kyau ga kasuwanci.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore Shiroro e bile le batho ba ditšhaba le ditumelo tše di fapanego, gomme se gape se be se loketše kgwebo.
Amharic: ሽሮሮ የተለያየ ጎሳ እና ሀይማኖት ያላቸው ሰዎች እንዳሉበት እና ይህ ደግሞ ለንግድ ስራ ጥሩ እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል።

English: This study challenges the findings of other researchers who reported that women have less business success because of being caretakers at home.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kusoomooza ebyazuulibwa abanoonyereza abalala abaategeeza nti abakyala balina obuwanguzi butono mu bizinensi kubanga be balabirira ewaka.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí ṣe ìpènijà fún àwon àwárí àwọn aṣèwádìí yóókù tí wọn jábọ̀ pé àwọn obìnrin ò fi bẹ́ẹ̀ ní àṣeyọrí nínú ìṣòwò nítorí wọ́n ń tọ́jú ilé.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo luphonsela inselelo imiphumela yabanye abacwaningi ababike ukuthi abesifazane banempumelelo encane kwezamabhizinisi ngenxa yokuba abanakekeli emakhaya.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya ƙalubalanci sakamakon binciken wasu masu bincike da suka bayar da rahoton cewa mata suna da ƙarancin nasara a harkokin kasuwanci saboda kasancewarsu masu kulawa da gida.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišiši tše di hlohla dikutollo tša banyakišiši ba bangwe bao ba begilego gore basadi ba atlega ga nnyane dikgwebong tša bona ka lebaka la ge e le bahlokomedi ka gae.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት ሴቶች በቤት ውስጥ ተንከባካቢ በመሆናቸው አነስተኛ የንግድ ስራ ስኬት እንዳላቸው ሪፖርት ያደረጉ የሌሎች ተመራማሪዎችን ግኝቶች ሞግቷል።

English: Instead, these researchers say that the success of business women in this area of Niger is impacted most by the threat of attacks by criminals and thieves.
Luganda: Wabula, abanoonyereza bano bagamba obuwanguzi bw’abakyala bannabizinensi mu kitongo kino mu Niger businga kukosebwa kulumbibwa kw’abamenyi b’amateeka n’ababbi.
Yoruba: Dípò èyí, àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé ìdojúkọ láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn olè àti ọ̀daràn ń kópa tó pọ̀ nínú àṣeyọrí àwọn obìnrin oníṣòwò agbègbè yìí ní Niger.
Zulu: Esikhundleni salokho, laba bacwaningi bathi impumelelo yabesifazane bebhizinisi kule ndawo yaseNiger ithintwa kakhulu usongo lokuhlaselwa yizigebengu namasela.
Hausa: A maimakon haka, waɗannan masu binciken sun ce nasarar da mata 'yan kasuwa suke samu a wannan yanki na Neja ya fi yin tasiri ne sakamakon barazanar hare-haren masu aikata laifuka da kuma ɓarayi.
Northern Sotho: Sebakeng seo, banyakišiši ba ba bolela gore katlego ya bengkgwebo ba basadi ka mo lefelong la Niger e angwa kudu ke tšhošetšo ya ditlhaselo ka basenyi le mahodu.
Amharic: ይልቁንም እነዚህ ተመራማሪዎች በዚህ በኒጀር አካባቢ ያሉ የንግድ ሴቶች ስኬት በአብዛኛው ተጽዕኖ የደረሰበት በወንጀለኞች እና በሌቦች ጥቃት ስጋት እንደሆነ ይናገራሉ።

English: The researchers recommended that all stakeholders should come together and fight against factors that could make it difficult to succeed in business.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baasemba nti abakwatibwako bonna balina okwegattira awamu balwanyise byonna ebiyinza okukaluubiriza okutuuka ku buwanguzi bizinensi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà dábàá pé gbogbo àwon tọ́rọ̀ náà kan, kí wón wà papọ̀ láti gbógun ti àwọn ohun tí ò jẹ́ kí òwò wọn jẹ́ àṣeyọrọ́.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bancome ukuthi bonke abathintekayo kumele bahlangane balwe nezinto ezingenza kube nzima ukuphumelela ebhizinisini.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar cewa duk masu ruwa da tsaki su hallara wuri guda don yaƙar abubuwan da za su iya sa wahalar samun nasara a kasuwanci.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šišintše gore batšeakarolo ka moka ba swanetše go kopana ba lwantšhe dilo tšeo di ka dirago gore go be boima go atlega kgwebong.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ሁሉም ባለድርሻ አካላት በአንድነት በመሰባሰብ በንግድ ስራ ስኬታማ ለመሆን አዳጋች ከሚያደርጉ ጉዳዮች ጋር መታገል እንዳለባቸው ምክረ ሃሳብ ሰጥተዋል።

English: For example, women in Niger should gain more access to funding, farms and safety.
Luganda: Okugeza, abakyala mu Niger balina okufuna we baggya ssente ewasingako, faamu ezisingako ate n’obutebenkevu obusingako.
Yoruba: Bí àpẹẹrẹ, owó, àwon oko àti ìdáàbòbò túnbọ̀ gbọdọ̀ súmọ́ àrọ́wọ́tó àwọn obìnrin Niger.
Zulu: Isibonelo, abesifazane baseNiger kufanele bathole ukufinyelela okwengeziwe okuthola imali, amapulazi kanye nokuphepha.
Hausa: Alal misali, ya kamata mata a Neja su ƙara samun kuɗaɗe da gonaki da kuma tsaro.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, basadi ka Niger ba swanetše go hwetša phihlelelo ye ntši go thušo ya ditšhelete, ya dipolasa le ya polokego.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ፣ በኒጀር ያሉ ሴቶች የበለጠ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ፣ እርሻ እና ደህንነት ማግኘት አለባቸው።

English: They also suggested that women in business could form groups that would help them fight against thieves and criminals.
Luganda: Era baateesa nti abakyala abali mu bizinensi bayinza okukola ebibiina ebiyinza okubayamba okulwanyisa ababbi n’abamenyi b’amateeka.
